Changing Form

A successful Incarnation switches to its initial form automatically. Feral Incarnation asks whether to begin in Bear Form or Cat Form.

While one or more Incarnations are active, use Change Form on the character sheet to switch between the available forms or return to Humanoid Form. The dialog lets you change form as an Action (0 WP) or a Free Action (1 WP).

Form Artwork

Use Druid Forms on the character sheet to choose the portrait and token artwork used for each form. Changes are saved per character and can be reset to the default artwork.

Ending Effects

Use End Effect on the character sheet or the End Effects player macro to end Bane of Azeroth-managed effects before their normal duration expires.
